svg.text: ppiDCE: Dual Cross-Encoder for PPI Classification
Adapts ESM-1b (Rives et al., 2021) for binary PPI prediction
Key Insight: ESM-1b is a single-sequence masked language model with NO
native protein-protein interaction capability. ppiDCE repurposes it by
exploiting the tokenizer's sentence-pair encoding mode.
| M K T I ... | | M S E Q ... |
| Two sequences concatenated into ONE input |
| | | FULL cross- | | ALL Seq_B to ALL | |
| default ESM-1b limit for longer sequences |
| Single protein | | Both proteins in ONE |
| No PPI ability | | attention at every layer |
Protein A Protein A Protein B
